s.note: crackers and whatever's left in his fridge
s.how: Cut 250g sharp cheddar into slabs and fold 150g sliced salami into quarters. Lay out on a chopping board with a sleeve of saltine crackers and a small bowl of pickled jalapeños. Eat it straight off the board on the couch.

s.note: the opening bust at the tree lot
s.how: Simmer 8 franks for 5 minutes, then griddle until blistered. Fry 2 sliced onions in oil until soft and golden. Steam 8 buns, fill with franks, onions and mustard, then wrap each in foil to keep warm until everyone is ready.

m.note: the family jokes about her cooking, make yours better
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Soften 1 onion, 2 carrots and 2 celery sticks, stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste, then add 250ml red wine, 500ml stock and thyme. Braise at 150C for 3 hours. Serve on 1kg potatoes mashed with butter.

w.note: fifty candles, he's too old for this
w.how: Beat 200g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs, then fold in 250g self-raising flour, 50g cocoa and 200ml milk. Bake in two tins at 170C for 35 minutes. Beat 200g butter, 300g icing sugar and 40g cocoa for buttercream. Fill, cover and add candles.

d.note: shared with the dog on the beach
d.how: Chill eight 375ml bottles of lager in the fridge for at least three hours, or in a bucket of ice and water for 30 minutes. Hand them out with the caps already off and drink straight from the bottle.
